Title: Azure Resource Manager template support for NSG flow logs

Body.Content:
Azure Resource Manager is a native and powerful way to manage your infrastructure as code. Now, Azure Resource Manager supports the deployment of network security group (NSG) flow logs through Azure Resource Manager templates. NSG flow logs are now an Azure Resource Manager resource so you have the ability to deploy flow logs programmatically and set up Azure Governance policies to verify that flow logs are enabled. 

To get started, read these resources:

  • [Tutorial] Enabling NSG Flow Logs from an Azure Resource Manager template 
  • Quickstart template for enabling NSG flow logs
  • NSG flow logs template reference
